This project is registered with an Engineering OS (EOS) installation. EOS provides
retrieval over a curated knowledge base through four tools -- `resolve`, `inspect`,
`expand` and `observe` -- available over MCP. The `ieos` CLI does not serve them yet.

The tools are available if you want them. Nothing here instructs you to call them,
and no tool call is required to complete work in this repository.

# Collapse spaces

## Goal

`collapseSpaces` should collapse runs of spaces to a single space, instead of
being a stub that returns its input unchanged.

## Approach

Replace runs of the literal space character with a single space, using a
regex replace. Leave other whitespace (tabs, newlines) untouched, since that
is `normalise`'s job, not this function's.

## DoD

- [ ] `collapseSpaces` collapses runs of spaces to one
- [ ] a test covers an input with multiple adjacent spaces
- [ ] the existing tests still pass
- [ ] no behaviour change for input with no repeated spaces
- [ ] CI is green on the pull request (merge gate; this is checked by CI
      itself once the PR is open, not something checked off ahead of time in
      this file)
